activity.role: Engineer and constructor of the Eiffel Tower
activity.notes: Gustave Eiffel was the engineer-contractor who led the Eiffel Tower project for the 1889 Exposition Universelle. ATLAS uses the tightly bounded construction phase, 1887-1889, as his representative French engineering Activity rather than stretching his multinational engineering and later scientific career across several decades.

sources.title: Eiffel Tower history, architecture, design & construction — Eiffel Tower official site
sources.citation_text: The official Eiffel Tower history states that construction began on 26 January 1887 and the Tower was completed on 31 March 1889.

sources.title: Gustave Eiffel, l’homme de fer — Archives nationales
sources.citation_text: The French National Archives describes Eiffel as the engineer whose technical achievements included the 1889 300-metre tower and major structures in France and abroad.
